covered_report_window: After the U.S. market close on Monday, October 12, 2026 through before the U.S. market open on Tuesday, October 13, 2026
market_context_summary: U.S. equities trade on Columbus Day while the cash bond market is closed. Major indexes enter bank earnings near records, the 10-year yield is near a multi-decade high, and Wednesday CPI is a nearby macro catalyst. Monday has no qualified investable after-close reporters; Tuesday pre-market is dominated by banks and healthcare.

methodology.disparity_definition: 0-100 composite dispersion of the three passes' direction and reversal-risk outputs; lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: No new method change. Existing mandatory expectation-bar, key-metric-first, forward-look override, and separate reversal-risk checks were applied.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic sales growth vs. Stelara erosion

ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: One preview sees pharma 1% above consensus; another flags under-modeled IPR&D dilution.
